findings.title: Residual settled-without-ledger window in redeem
findings.detail: If the two-item TransactWriteItems commits and the GCTXN#/GCTXNID# puts then fail, a retry reads the settled claim, answers from the replay branch and returns without writing them. void() resolves exclusively through GCTXNID#<transactionId> and raises TransactionNotFound with no row, so the balance cannot be returned through this layer, while the SPI has already answered Wix with that transactionId. Pre-existing in kind: the same gap existed between _mark_settled and the ledger puts at 32b632e3, and this change removes the other window (money moved, claim unsettled) outright rather than adding one. _record_balance_after is one new best-effort UpdateItem inside it.
findings.action: No action required for this change. Worth a recovery path when the SPI void surface is next touched.

findings.title: demo_code's docstring publishes its own output for the default demo reference
findings.detail: The docstring names b4a4841861208fa8 as the digest fragment shared between demo_code and idempotency_key for 'wd-gc-sample-2026-10-02', so the full demo code for that reference is reconstructable from source as WDGC plus that fragment upper-cased. Consistent with demo_code being unkeyed and non-bearer, and nothing is spendable because the transport is stubbed unconditionally.
findings.action: Keep the AST reference gate (test_no_file_under_amplify_references_the_demo_only_derivation) as the fence; do not read the docstring as implying the value is withheld.
